snippet.title: [PSX] Wedding Peach - Doki Doki Oiro-naoshi (Japan)
snippet.description: Ok, so in this game, you dress up in different outfits to have funny scenes play out... I guess. Maybe fight evil? Who knows. It's based on an anime.
